entities.name: Kitanosu
entities.description: A nezumi village with a derelict temple in the Takenuma swamp on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Azami Ozu
entities.description: A Minamo student who abandoned her friend Etsumi to take General Sonzaki's documents.

entities.name: Etsumi Urano
entities.description: Azami's friend, who fell into quicksand.

entities.name: General Sonzaki
entities.description: Hid his battle plans and journal in the temple shrine.

entities.name: Horobi
entities.description: The kami of death's wail that haunted Kitanosu during the Kami War.

entities.name: Forked-Tongue
entities.description: Shaman who told villagers to sacrifice someone to Horobi.

entities.name: Sonokura
entities.description: A human drunkard and outcast chosen as sacrifice to Horobi.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which Horobi haunted Kitanosu.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: School where Azami and Etsumi studied.

events.summary: Azami and Etsumi sneak into Kitanosu Temple to find General Sonzaki's documents and are spotted.
events.quote: They found the documents but were spotted by the ochimusa, who alerted the village's nezumi.

events.summary: Azami prioritizes the documents over her friend, leaving Etsumi to die.
events.quote: Azami prioritized the documents over her friend, leaving Etsumi to die

events.summary: During the Kami War the villagers decide to sacrifice Sonokura to appease Horobi.
events.quote: they decided to sacrifice Sonokura , a human drunkard and outcast

relations.note: Friends who studied together at Minamo.
relations.quote: Azami Ozu and her friend Etsumi Urano
